speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The text is plain, and I shall keep it plain. A Sunday is not a counting of heads.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Plain will do, Master Thwaite. I have the book in one hand and the door in the other.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am in, Mistress. I am not adding a head to his count.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The south aisle, sir, same as always. I have your place.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Sit, then. The sand is not turned for a show. You will hear the lesson and you will go to your dinner.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: We will. He pays for his dinner when he sits, and he is sitting after church, not during it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: After. I have a sheet to write, and I will not write it in a pew.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: No ink on a Sunday pew, sir. She would see it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then take the lesson and leave the pew as you found it. That is the whole of my asking.
